notes: Bare Macauley is shared by Patch and Ivy (and Joseph Henry Macauley is Patch). In the text Ivy behaves as Patch's mother (Patch: 'you're all I've got'; 'Ivy would not have her son back'), not a sibling. Saint is a first name whose surname Brown appears only 3x (Special Agent Saint Brown); Saint Paul/Malo/Bernard/Barbara are place/dog uses.
